rows: Same rule name in another department
Names only need to be unique inside a department. "GDS B2B", "GDS B2C", "Airline Ops", "LCC", "KSA" are each used in up to 4 departments.
Refused: "A rule named 'QA NDC GDS B2B' already exists in this module. Rule names must be unique per module." Renaming works around it.
The rule list is per department (department picker).
The rule belongs to QA NDC Quality Assurance; the existing one to QA NDC Financial approval.
